selection: 192 fixed neuron pairs: the 29 featured surprising pairs, 67 existing pairs with contrasting saved replies, and 96 previously untested pairings from a fixed diverse parent pool. Candidate selection fixed before this generation.
normalization: Signed unit effective MLP write column, including learned MLP gain, multiplied by prompt residual median norm and dose; added after the block at all positions.
judging: Codex editorial review of deduplicated discovery replies and selected pair replies; mechanical triage is not a quality or identity judge. Unreviewed outputs retain no invented ratings.
goal: Find surprising readable pair outcomes and semantic transitions as total intervention strength or parent balance changes; literal blending is not required.
limitations: Exploratory editorial selection, not a population estimate
Screening previews are 64 tokens; review full continuations for finalists
One prompt and greedy decoding; numerical batch effects may alter exact replies
A strength factor multiplies each parent’s saved solo dose; .5× need not be the same absolute coefficient across parents
Semantic changes are judged from replies; lexical differences are only triage aids
